    - text: PHASE 1 · SPECIAL FUNCTIONS
    - heading "Error Function" [level=1]
    - paragraph: The error function is a scaled, signed Gaussian integral from 0 to x.
    - text: "#2023 · 15 min · Advanced · Special Functions"
    - heading "Interactive Lab" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Accumulated Gaussian area and its corresponding error-function value.
    - link "Open studio":

      - text: Open studio

    - heading "Gaussian Accumulation Lab" [level=2]
    - button "Reset":

      - text: Reset

      - img

      - img
    - article:
      - heading "1A · Gaussian kernel and accumulated area" [level=3]
      - math: y = e − t 2 , ∫ 0 x e − t 2 d t
      - group "gaussian curve at x 1": 0 0.2 0.4 0.6 0.8 1 -3 -2 -1 0 1 2 3
      - complementary:
        - text: x =
        - spinbutton "Gaussian upper limit x": "1"
        - slider "Gaussian upper limit slider": "1"
        - paragraph: Signed integral
        - strong: "0.7468241328"
        - text: This is the unscaled Gaussian area, not erf(x).
    - article:
      - heading "1B · Error function" [level=3]
      - math: erf ⁡ ( x ) = 2 π ∫ 0 x e − t 2 d t
      - group "erf curve at x 1": "-1 -0.5 0 0.5 1 -3 -2 -1 0 1 2 3"
      - complementary:
        - heading "erf(1.000)" [level=3]
        - strong: "0.8427007929"
        - heading "Odd Symmetry" [level=3]
        - paragraph: erf(−x) = -0.84270079
        - heading "Derivative" [level=3]
        - paragraph: erf′(x) = 0.41510750
        - paragraph: The curve approaches −1 and 1 without attaining them at finite x.
    - complementary:
      - heading "Key Properties" [level=2]
      - heading "Definition" [level=3]
      - math: erf ⁡ ( x ) = 2 π ∫ 0 x e − t 2 d t
      - heading "Odd symmetry" [level=3]
      - math: erf ⁡ ( − x ) = − erf ⁡ ( x )
      - heading "Limits" [level=3]
      - math: lim ⁡ x → ∞ erf ⁡ ( x ) = 1
      - math: lim ⁡ x → − ∞ erf ⁡ ( x ) = − 1
      - heading "Derivative" [level=3]
      - math: erf ⁡ ′ ( x ) = 2 π e − x 2
      - heading "Link to Normal CDF" [level=2]
      - math: Φ ( z ) = 1 2 [ 1 + erf ⁡ ( z 2 ) ]
      - heading "Current z = x = 1" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Φ(1) = 0.8413447461
      - heading "Checkpoint" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Φ(1) = 0.8413447461
    - article:
      - heading "Diffusion Profile (Heat Equation)" [level=2]
      - math: u ( z , t ) = 1 4 π α t e − z 2 / ( 4 α t )
      - text: αt
      - combobox "Diffusivity times time":
        - option "0.1"
        - option "0.25" [selected]
        - option "0.5"
        - option "1"
        - option "2"
      - img "Diffusion profile at diffusivity times time 0.25": 0 0.2 0.4 0.6 -3 -2 -1 0 1 2 3
      - paragraph: Total mass on the full real line = 1.
      - text: Only z ∈ [−3,3] is displayed; wider profiles extend beyond this window.
    - article:
      - heading "Complementary Error Function" [level=2]
      - math: erfc ⁡ ( x ) = 1 − erf ⁡ ( x )
      - img "erfc curve at x 1": 0 0.5 1 1.5 2 -3 -2 -1 0 1 2 3
      - paragraph: erfc(1.000)
      - strong: "0.1572992071"
      - text: erfc decreases from 2 toward 0 across the real line.
    - article:
      - heading "Normal CDF Φ(z)" [level=2]
      - math: Φ ( z ) = 1 2 [ 1 + erf ⁡ ( z / 2 ) ]
      - img "normal curve at x 1": 0 0.2 0.4 0.6 0.8 1 -3 -2 -1 0 1 2 3
      - paragraph: Φ(1.000)
      - strong: "0.8413447461"
    - article:
      - heading "Study & Practice" [level=2]

        - text: The unscaled integral of e⁻ᵗ² from 0 to x.
        - radio "The symmetric area from −x to x."
        - text: The symmetric area from −x to x.
        - radio "The value of erf(x) directly."
        - text: The value of erf(x) directly.
      - text: 3. Use odd symmetry to find erf(1) from erf(−1) ≈ −0.842700793
